meta.description: DQ expectations for Gold (business-facing, aggregated/dimensional) tables. Gold has the strictest expectations — it backs dashboards and downstream ML. Zero tolerance for nulls on key metrics. Tune row count bounds after observing 30 days of production data.
meta.when_to_run: After Gold write. Alert on-call if suite fails — Gold failures directly affect business reporting.

meta.notes: Gold tables are aggregates — fewer than 100 rows likely indicates a broken join or filter. Tune min_value to typical daily row count * 0.8.
Replace 'dimension_key' with your primary key. Gold must have zero null keys — no exceptions.
Gold dimension keys must be unique. Fact tables: scope uniqueness to composite grain.
Replace 'metric_value' with your primary KPI column. Null metrics break dashboard aggregations and ML feature pipelines.
Metrics should never be negative unless your domain explicitly allows it (e.g. returns/credits). Set max_value to 3x typical peak.
Every Gold row must be anchored to a reporting date for time-series dashboards.
Report dates before 2020 are almost always pipeline bugs — adjust to your data history start date.
Domain invariant: refunds cannot exceed revenue. Replace with your own business rule pair. Remove if not applicable.
